name: Original Pigeon Point Reef video-lander drops

producer.name: The Nature Conservancy and Moss Landing Marine Laboratories

rights.requested_review: Raw-drop access and any public derivative or coordinate-sharing terms

temporal.update_cadence: Static historical survey; quarterly discovery until original table or custodian response is reviewed

evidence.supports: TNC reports video-lander fish observations at named Pigeon Point Reef, without the original georeferenced drop table.

MLML/TNC method records GPS at drops, fish MaxN and effort, but published analysis groups study locations too broadly for W00614 cell overlap. This paper is a method lead, not proof that its samples are the same 2016 drops.

promotion_blockers: Original drop coordinates and their bottom-position errors are unavailable.
No drop has been shown to intersect W00614's measured 200–300 ft cells.
No zero-detection effort or exact taxon/habitat table has been reviewed.
Reuse and public-coordinate terms are unreviewed.
